cues.en: And so when we're adding new features, we always try to be very deliberate. We want to consider a bunch of things when deciding whether to add a new API.

cues.en: What I'd like to ask is what in React still sucks?
cues.zh: 我想问的是，React 里还有哪些地方依然很糟？

cues.en: And I have three problems that I would like to talk through.
cues.zh: 我有三个问题想逐一谈谈。

cues.en: The first one is reusing logic between multiple components.
cues.zh: 第一个是在多个组件之间复用逻辑。

cues.en: In React,
cues.zh: 在 React 里，

cues.en: our main building block for our applications is a component and components form the foundation of the two main patterns for sharing code in React apps between components,
cues.zh: 我们应用的主要构建单元是组件，而组件构成了 React 应用中组件之间共享代码的两种主要模式的基础，

cues.en: which are higher order components and render props.
cues.zh: 也就是高阶组件和 render props。

cues.en: Both of these patterns are great for some cases, but they also come with a significant downside.
cues.zh: 这两种模式在某些情况下都很好，但它们也都有一个明显的缺点。

cues.en: You need to restructure your app anytime you want to pull one of these in. In more complicated examples,
cues.zh: 每当你想引入其中一个，都得重构应用。在更复杂的示例中，

cues.en: this leads to what I call wrapper hell.
cues.zh: 这就会导致我所说的包装器地狱。

cues.en: Most of us have seen component trees that look something like this.
cues.zh: 我们大多数人见过类似这样的组件树。

cues.en: And
cues.zh: 而且

cues.en: the the nesting you end up with makes it difficult to follow the data flow through the app. Would It be really nice if there was some way to reuse this sort of stateful logic without needing to change the component hierarchy. Right?
cues.zh: 最终得到的这层嵌套会让你很难跟踪整个应用中的数据流。如果能有某种方式复用这类有状态逻辑，而不需要改动组件层级，那该多好。对吧？

cues.en: The second problem I would like to talk about is giant components whose logic is just sort of a tangled mess. When you look at a thousand line React component, chances are the logic is going to be split across a lot of different lifecycle methods in a way that's pretty difficult to follow.
cues.zh: 我想讲的第二个问题，是巨型组件，里面的逻辑乱成一团。当你看到一个上千行的 React 组件时，逻辑很可能被拆散到许多不同的生命周期方法里，让人很难跟得上。

cues.zh: 我们来看一个例子。

cues.en: Let's say we have a class component, and in its componentDidMount method, it does a few different things. It subscribes to a data store, it sends off a network request, and it starts a timer.
cues.zh: 假设我们有一个类组件，在它的 componentDidMount 方法里做了几件不同的事：订阅了一个数据存储，发出一个网络请求，还启动了一个定时器。

cues.en: Well,
cues.zh: 嗯，

cues.en: if we look at the componentWillUnmount
cues.zh: 如果我们看看 componentWillUnmount

cues.en: method, then we're going to see basically the exact three opposite things. It needs to unsubscribe from the store, it needs to cancel that network request, and it needs to stop the timers.
cues.zh: 方法，那么基本上会看到完全相反的三件事。它需要取消对 store 的订阅，需要取消那个网络请求，还需要停止定时器。

cues.en: And when it comes to implementing componentDidUpdate,
cues.zh: 而到了实现 componentDidUpdate 时，

cues.en: the logic tends to get even trickier because you need to compare the old and new props and
cues.zh: 逻辑往往会变得更棘手，因为你需要比较新旧 props，并且

cues.en: also mirror,
cues.zh: 还要镜像处理，

cues.en: again, the same tasks that you have in your other lifecycle methods.
cues.zh: 也就是再次处理你在其他生命周期方法中要做的相同任务。

cues.en: In this example,
cues.zh: 在这个示例中，

cues.en: each call here is just one line. So this is actually a lot simpler than what you normally see your components. In real world components, you often end up with an even more tangled mess because each
cues.zh: 这里的每个调用都只有一行。所以这实际上比你们通常看到的组件要简单得多。在真实世界的组件中，你往往会陷入更加纠缠不清的混乱，因为每个

cues.zh: 单独的任务都必须拆分到不同的生命周期方法中。这就让人很难看出，比如，你在卸载组件时是否忘记清理某个资源。从代码里很难看出这一点。

cues.en: And the third thing that sucks
cues.zh: 第三件让人头疼的事

cues.en: is that understanding
cues.zh: 是理解

cues.en: classes in JavaScript can be pretty tricky. And today, we require you to
cues.zh: JavaScript 中的类可能相当棘手。而如今，我们要求你

cues.zh: 使用类组件来访问状态和生命周期。

cues.en: If you've ever taken a function component and converted it to a class to add some state, you know that there's a fair amount of boilerplate that's required in order to just define a class component.
cues.zh: 如果你曾把函数组件改成类来添加一些状态，你就知道，仅仅定义一个类组件就需要相当多的样板代码。

cues.en: Most beginners and many experienced devs also tell us
cues.zh: 大多数初学者和许多有经验的开发者也告诉我们

cues.en: that
cues.zh: 说

cues.en: the way binding and this work in classes is pretty confusing.
cues.zh: 类中绑定和 this 的工作方式相当令人困惑。

cues.en: It's annoying to have to think about.
cues.zh: 老是得考虑这件事，很烦。

cues.en: And we also frequently hear that people don't exactly know when to use function components partly because there's always this fear that you're going to have to convert it to a class later anyway, and so you're like, should I should I do it now? I don't know.
cues.zh: 我们还经常听到，人们并不确切知道什么时候该用函数组件，部分原因是总担心以后还是得把它改成类组件，所以你会想：我是不是该现在就改？我也不知道。

cues.zh: 所以我认为

cues.en: classes are hard for humans.

cues.zh: 但不只是人类，

cues.zh: 我们发现类会助长一些模式，让我们的编译器更难优化。

cues.en: So here are the three problems that we have. Reusing logic,

cues.zh: 巨型组件，

cues.en: and
cues.zh: 以及

cues.en: and classes. So reusing logic because you often end up with this wrapper hell, giant components because you have the logic split across different life cycles
cues.zh: 以及类。之所以说复用逻辑，是因为你常常会陷入包装器地狱；巨型组件则是因为逻辑被拆散在不同的生命周期里

cues.en: and classes,
